data.collector.yaml:
# This is a deployment input, not a running deployment. The operator must bind
# the OTLP receiver only to the declared in-cluster Service and separately prove
# the collector, trace store, and Prometheus scrape path in the target lab.
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318

processors:
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 1s
    limit_mib: 256
    spike_limit_mib: 64
  attributes/drop-unsafe:
    actions:
      - key: http.request.header.authorization
        action: delete
      - key: http.request.body
        action: delete
      - key: http.response.body
        action: delete
      - key: gen_ai.prompt
        action: delete
      - key: gen_ai.completion
        action: delete
      - key: runtime.model.reasoning
        action: delete
      - key: runtime.tool.output
        action: delete
      - key: process.command_args
        action: delete
  batch:
    send_batch_size: 512
    timeout: 1s

exporters:
  # The trace store is deliberately an in-cluster DNS name. Authentication and
  # any external export are not part of this reusable collector contract.
  otlphttp/trace-store:
    endpoint: http://trace-store:4318
    compression: gzip
    timeout: 5s
  prometheus:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:8889
    resource_to_telemetry_conversion:
      enabled: false

service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, attributes/drop-unsafe, batch]
      exporters: [otlphttp/trace-store]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, attributes/drop-unsafe, batch]
      exporters: [prometheus]

kubernetes.name: blob-reconciler
arguments: mc alias set runtime http://blob:9000 "$MINIO_ROOT_USER" "$MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD" >/dev/null; mc mb --ignore-existing runtime/"$BLOB_BUCKET" >/dev/null; mc mb --ignore-existing runtime/"$BLOB_TEMPORAL_BUCKET" >/dev/null; exec sleep infinity
